verdict.rationale: Morph is an LLM API and inference platform, so accepting external MCP servers (for example, remote MCP tool calling through its endpoints) is a fair question for this kind of product. However, all MCP evidence describes Morph's own MCP server, which exposes edit_file and codebase_search to clients like Claude Code. That is the server role, not the ability to plug other MCP servers into Morph, so it earns no credit here. No evidence shows Morph consuming third-party MCP servers or their tools.
